title: The Captain & Her First Mate
text: It was a beautiful, sunny, but windy day in Barcelona for our boat trip. Captain Erica & Eugene were very aware and explained we may not be able to go outside the sea wall. We trusted their judgement and appreciated their concern for our safety. They did a great job making our trip inside the wall a great experience. Eugene did a great job keeping our plates & drinks full, and Erica made sure we knew all the history & current events in the Old Harbor. We enjoyed our cruise and appreciated their knowledge of sailing & history.
author: kim6075JJ

title: Top Notch Private Tour
text: My wife and I enjoyed this cruise very much. Worth every penny. We were treated to Victoria and Fredericka. Two personable lovely captains that attended to our every need while giving us a wonderful trip on the Mediterranean.
author: Joseph_C

title: White Sails, Blue Waves and Happy smiles dancing with the wind!
text:
An exceptional taste of Barcelona from the sea, I was lucky enough to set sail for a sunset experience with Sea Barcelona.

As a solo traveller, I totally recommend to join the fantastic crew, while they treat the trip passengers with cava, wine, local pica-pica delis and a very warm welcome to make everybody feel we are all friends for our time on board.

I was there with captain Victoria and sailor Camilo, and felt very safe on the sailing time.

And then, what to say of the BEST of It:
Barcelona from the Med Sea is worth viewing and experience for perspective and learning. To imagine so man
author: schminckeb

title: The most wonderful sailing trip
text: Our sailing experience was truly amazing. The staff were more than welcoming and provided us with fun facts, amazing service and positive vibes throughout the trip. We loved every minute of the trip. Would definitely recommend!

title: Wonderful sunset experience!
text: Wonderful sail! The hospitality was A+...snack were tasty and the drinks were always full! (There is a restroom on board)

title: VERY GOOD experience, manily thanks to the crew. Definately worth the money.
text:
The tour was simply perfect.
Nice big boat (Mishka), we were only 4 so had plenty of room.
The crew was fantastic (Gigi and Eduardo), they were so nice and had a positive vibe.
Very good (local) cava and snacks (lives, crisps, cheese)
author: Doke_1

title: Amazing experience, the best part of our trip to Barcelona.
text: Did a sunset cruise on our last night in Barcelona and it was amazing! The boat was beautiful and Eduardo and the crew gave us an amazing experience. Would 100% recommend this to anyone traveling to Barcelona.

title: The most beautiful anniversary celebration
text: One of the best experiences in our lives. We celebrated our engagement anniversary on a boat with a view of Barcelona and pleasant guitar music. The captain was amazing, skilled and funny. The sea was beautiful and the view of Barcelona even more so. It was a bit windy, but that's part of sailing, so it was ok for us. The most beautiful anniversary celebration.

title: Barcelona highlight
text: Highlight of our trip! We had a wonderful time watching the sunset and cruising around the Harbour. Highly recommended!
